{{Top|leg}}
'''Sector 5-7''' was an area of [[Magma/Legends|lava plains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Turak IV]]. During the [[Battle of Turak IV]], [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortank]] [[Hammer 4:3]] was disabled in Sector 5-7 and became the target of salvage operations by both [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] forces.
